description: Suggest up to three live catalog services for a task on one payment rail, within a spending ceiling. No payment or task execution occurs; review endpoint inputs and fee legs. Rail and asset must be a settleable pair (canonical map, src/rails.mjs): Base/Arc/Solana settle in USDC, XRPL in XRP or RLUSD, Xahau in XAH, MultiversX in EGLD, MEX or USDC — any other pair is rejected with an error, never silently re-railed.

asset.description: Asset label; must pair with network: Base→USDC, Arc→USDC, XRPL→XRP or RLUSD, Xahau→XAH, Solana→USDC, MultiversX→EGLD, MEX or USDC.

budget.description: Spending ceiling as a decimal string, up to 6 decimal places.

name: plan_mission
title: Plan a budgeted mission
